prompt: Bug report from a user: "Track files exported from my Garmin app fail with `trailhead: line 1: expected the header 'lat,lon,ele'`, but when I open one in my editor the first line is exactly `lat,lon,ele`. One of the files is attached as `garmin-export.csv`." Find the cause and fix it.
bash_commands: od -c garmin-export.csv | head -20; echo; cat -A garmin-export.csv
grep -rn "parse_track\|load_track\|read_text\|encoding" src tests README.md; echo ---; cat tests/test_track.py; echo ---; cat tests/conftest.py | head -40; echo ---; cat pyproject.toml

python3 -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'src'); from trailhead.track import load_track
t=load_track('garmin-export.csv'); print(t.name, len(t.points), round(t.length_km(),3))
" && PYTHONPATH=src python3 -I -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -3; (ruff check src tests 2>&1 || python3 -m ruff check src tests 2>&1) | tail -2; git diff --stat

python3 -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'src'); from trailhead.track import load_track
t=load_track('garmin-export.csv'); print(t.name, len(t.points), round(t.length_km(),3))"
git diff --stat && (which ruff && ruff check src tests) ; echo "ruff exit: $?"
